newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates stay high in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates stay high in tight market.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates remained steady at high levels on Thursday amid a shortage of liquidity and dealers said rates were likely to open at similar levels after the Friday weekend.
"As expected, overnight call money rates traded at the same levels," dealer Imran Ahad at Standard Chartered Bank said, adding deals were done at 20 percent.
He said most of the banks used the discount window facility of the State (central) Bank of Pakistan and discounted an estimated 15 billion rupees.
